biotools.summary: The Antigen-Antibody Complex Database (AACDB) provides a comprehensive collection of 7498 manually processed antigen-antibody complexes, rectifying annotation errors and integrating data on antibody developability and antigen-drug target relationships. It is designed to be a valuable resource for immunoinformatics research and antibody therapy development.
